full_name: Rosemary Ida Kabahuma | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Biological Sciences Helen Putnam Fellow University of Pretoria (South Africa)
bio: Rosemary Ida Kabahuma is an otorhinolaryngologist, a head and neck surgeon, and a scientist with special interest in hearing loss and inner-ear function whose research focuses on the search for deafness genes among sub-Saharan African populations.
